parameters.query:
-- Written by n8n's error workflow for every unhandled failure in the other workflows.
-- No foreign keys on purpose: this must work even when the application tables are broken.
INSERT INTO workflow_errors (workflow_name, execution_id, node_name, message, details)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb)
RETURNING id, created_at;

options.queryReplacement:
={{ [
  $json.workflow?.name ?? 'unknown',
  ($json.execution?.id ?? '').toString(),
  $json.execution?.lastNodeExecuted ?? null,
  $json.execution?.error?.message ?? 'unknown error',
  JSON.stringify({
    execution_url: $json.execution?.url ?? null,
    mode: $json.execution?.mode ?? null,
    retry_of: $json.execution?.retryOf ?? null,
    error_name: $json.execution?.error?.name ?? null,
    description: $json.execution?.error?.description ?? null,
    stack: ($json.execution?.error?.stack ?? '').toString().slice(0, 2000)
  })
] }}
